rows: Inspect supported source operations and native or indexed search coverage

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Inspect supported source operations and native or indexed search coverage. One row per source_id and operation. Join this relation to sources using source_id to obtain the endpoint and authentication settings. supported reports adapter support even when an index has not been prepared. Package operations are search, package, versions, artifacts and dependencies; container operations are search, repository, tags, manifest, platforms, layers and configuration. searched_fields is a comma-separated list for search and NULL for other operations. Inspect description for operation-specific limits. This relation is both a table and a zero-argument function. Result columns (nullable when upstream data is unavailable): source_id `VARCHAR`: Configured source identifier. ecosystem `VARCHAR`: Adapter ecosystem. operation `VARCHAR`: Operation name. supported `BOOLEAN`: Whether this adapter supports the operation. search_mode `VARCHAR`: native or indexed for search. searched_fields `VARCHAR`: Fields included in search. authentication `VARCHAR`: Configured authentication mode. description `VARCHAR`: Operation constraints.

Inspect prepared index readiness, revisions, freshness and discovery boundaries

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Inspect prepared index readiness, revisions, freshness and discovery boundaries. One row per source_id describing search readiness. Join to sources using source_id for endpoint details. Indexed sources report the last committed snapshot, observation time, source revision, record count, checkpoint, declared coverage and completeness. complete means the declared input was exhausted, not ecosystem-wide coverage. Native readiness indicates adapter availability, not a remote health probe. Failed inspection produces ready=false and a safe error code. This relation is both a table and a zero-argument function. Result columns (nullable when upstream data is unavailable): source_id `VARCHAR`: Configured source identifier. ecosystem `VARCHAR`: Adapter ecosystem. ready `BOOLEAN`: Whether search can use the configured source. search_mode `VARCHAR`: native or indexed. complete `BOOLEAN`: Index input exhausted within declared boundaries; NULL for native search. coverage `VARCHAR`: Declared index scope. searched_fields `VARCHAR`: Indexed fields. snapshot_id `VARCHAR`: Unique identifier for the last atomically committed index refresh. source_revision `VARCHAR`: Upstream revision or checkpoint. observed_at `VARCHAR`: Last successful index refresh. records `BIGINT`: Stored metadata record count. checkpoint `VARCHAR`: Resume cursor for incremental feeds. stale `BOOLEAN`: Index older than configured freshness interval. error `VARCHAR`: Safe status error code if inspection failed.

List configured software sources and their optional authentication modes

rows.vgi.doc_llm: List configured software sources and their optional authentication modes. One row per configured source. Use source_id to call registry functions. Endpoint URLs are sanitized; authentication reports anonymous, auto, or required. credential_configured describes environment/file references, not SQL-secret availability. search_mode distinguishes native provider search from a prepared local index. This relation is available as both a table and a zero-argument function. Result columns (nullable when upstream data is unavailable): source_id `VARCHAR`: Configured source identifier. ecosystem `VARCHAR`: Adapter ecosystem. endpoint `VARCHAR`: Configured upstream URL. authentication `VARCHAR`: anonymous, auto, or required. credential_configured `BOOLEAN`: Whether the configuration references a credential; SQL secrets may also apply. search_mode `VARCHAR`: native or indexed search. metadata `VARCHAR`: Configured source boundaries as JSON.
